title: Responsible Artificial Intelligence
description: Fundamental concepts and models of artificial intelligence and their limitations. Benefits and risks of artificial intelligence in engineering practice and products. Regulations, policies and ethical standards of responsible applications of artificial intelligence. Intellectual property rights and artificial intelligence.
notes: The majority of content for this course will be taught face-to-face in a compact format during tri-annual mandatory conferences that will be attended by all students in the DEng program. Some additional course content may be delivered online.
